blocks.label: Style
blocks.body: noir jazz, 92 BPM, in A minor, upright bass, muted trumpet, brush kit, instrumental, tape saturation, melancholic

blocks.label: Arrangement
blocks.body: Start with just brushed drums and upright bass, bring in the trumpet at 0:20.

flat: noir jazz, 92 BPM, in A minor, upright bass, muted trumpet, brush kit, instrumental, tape saturation, melancholic. Start with just brushed drums and upright bass, bring in the trumpet at 0:20.
notes: BPM and key both work on the major models. State them as numbers and letters, not as 'fast' and 'sad'.
warnings: Section metatags like [Chorus] are a Suno and ElevenLabs convention. Check your tool before pasting them.

variations.name: Strip it back
variations.text: Same genre and tempo, half the instrumentation. Name only two instruments and let the arrangement breathe.

variations.name: Change the era
variations.text: Keep everything, add one era marker: 80s gated reverb, or 90s tape saturation. Era markers do a lot of work.

variations.name: Loop version
variations.text: Ask for the negative space explicitly: no melody, just the rhythm section, eight bars, seamless.
